title: Priority Health Partners with Kivo Health
body_markdown: We’re partnering with[Priority Health](https://www.priorityhealth.com/) , Michigan’s second-largest health plan - covering 1.3M lives - to bring our AI-powered virtual COPD care program to members across the state. Together, we’re delivering AI-powered, scalable, in-home care to empower people with COPD avoid preventable hospitalizations and manage their condition from home, resulting in reduced costs and healthier seniors. This partnership is a major step toward scaling value-based, outcomes-driven virtual care for seniors with high cost chronic diseases nationwide. Read the full press release[here](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251211092754/en/Priority-Health-Partners-With-Kivo-Health-to-Deliver-AI-Powered-Virtual-COPD-Care) .
